own_account_rfi_multiple.source: POLICY.md 'Policy settings': 'When transfers between the customer's own accounts explain activity at 5 times the declared income or volume or more, send an RFI for an updated expected income or volume. Below 5 times, close.'

own_account_evidence.source: POLICY.md 'Policy settings': 'An account in the customer's own name elsewhere counts as their own account only when a document on file shows the customer holds it.'

high_risk_countries.source: POLICY.md 'Policy settings': 'Higher-risk countries as of 1 October 2026: Afghanistan, Belarus, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Myanmar, North Korea, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Syria, Venezuela, Yemen.'

list_match.source: POLICY.md 'Policy settings': 'Close a list match only when the evidence shows the counterparty is a different party. If nothing on file settles it either way and nothing else is concerning, send an RFI. If the evidence shows the listed party is the counterparty or controls it, escalate.'

previous_review.source: POLICY.md 'Policy settings': 'An earlier review covers only what it describes. It does not explain new or larger activity.'

context_only.source: POLICY.md 'Policy settings': 'Round amounts, a shared device, IP address or contact details, a recipient added the same day, and crypto or gambling counterparties add context. None of them raises an alert on its own.'
